review_findings: No correctness issue found in the reviewed source.
Existing exhaustive random-energy reference covers all public term APIs and copy/move/clear/init/swap.
Existing boundary tests exercise finite budget unsigned-max-minus-one, optimum overflow repair, contradictory constraints, and signed minimum costs.
Existing allocation injection covers rollback of grouped additions and object lifecycle/solve allocation failures.
The added test addresses the existing gap between a single long chain and branching/rerouting beyond the recursive depth bound.

iterative_flow can safely advance the parent cursor when the child returns short: either that edge is saturated or the child exhausted all admissible descendants; if the parent limit is reached its cursor stays.
Scratch storage is reserved before any augmentation, so flow mutation cannot be interrupted by scratch allocation failure.
Finite total capacity remains strictly below the unsigned maximum; contradiction testing stops after at most finite+1 total flow, avoiding unsigned overflow.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, time

root = Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env')
base = Path('/tmp/sirkit_project_ready_20261025')
result = {'date': '2026-10-25', 'standard': 'C++23', 'runs': [], 'source_hashes': {}}
def digest(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
paths = ['Graph/Project_Selection.cpp', 'Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp',
         'Verify/current/drivers/project_selection_main.cpp',
         'Verify/current/submissions/project_selection.cpp',
         'Examples/project_selection_example.cpp']
paths += [f'Verify/current/tests/project_selection_{name}' for name in
          ['reference_test.cpp', 'exception_test.cpp', 'deep_flow_test.cpp', 'cases.py']]
for path in paths: result['source_hashes'][path] = digest(root / path)
def save():
    (base / 'validation-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
def command(args, **kwargs):
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, timeout=180, **kwargs)
    if p.returncode:
        print(p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), p.stderr.decode(errors='replace'), flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError(f'command failed: {args}')
    return p
def build(compiler, flags, source, target):
    args = ['taskset', '-c', '6', *compiler, '-std=c++23', '-O2',
            '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-pedantic', *flags, str(source), '-o', str(target)]
    p = command(args)
    if p.stderr: (base / (target.name + '.compile.log')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
    return args, p.stderr.decode()

command(['python3', str(root / 'Verify/current/tests/project_selection_cases.py'),
         '--output-dir', str(base / 'fixtures')])
cases = json.loads((base / 'fixtures/cases.json').read_text())
result['fixtures'] = {'total':len(cases), 'official':sum(x['official_sample'] for x in cases),
                      'full_enumeration':sum(x['n'] <= 12 for x in cases)}
submission = (root / 'Verify/current/submissions/project_selection.cpp').read_text()
(base / 'main-checked.cpp').write_text(submission.replace('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n', '', 1))
(base / 'main-skip.cpp').write_text(submission)
(base / 'duplicate.cpp').write_text('#include "' + str(root / 'Graph/Project_Selection.cpp') + '"\n' * 1 +
    '#include "' + str(root / 'Graph/Project_Selection.cpp') + '"\n' +
    'int main(){TwoVariableSubmodularOpt<> m(0);return int(m.solve());}\n')
example_output = b'-3\n1 1 0 \n-3\n0\n5 3\n7\n'
for name, compiler in [('gcc', ['/usr/bin/g++']), ('clang', ['/usr/bin/clang++',
        '--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
    for skip in [False, True]:
        label = f'{name}-' + ('skip' if skip else 'checked')
        flags = ['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS'] if skip else []
        for test in ['reference', 'exception', 'deep_flow']:
            source = root / f'Verify/current/tests/project_selection_{test}_test.cpp'
            target = base / (label + '-' + test)
            args, diagnostics = build(compiler, flags, source, target)
            p = command(['taskset', '-c', '10', str(target)])
            result['runs'].append({'kind':'unit', 'config':label, 'test':test,
                'compile':args, 'diagnostics':diagnostics, 'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),
                'stderr':p.stderr.decode(), 'exit':p.returncode})
            save(); print(label, test, p.stdout.decode().strip(), flush=True)
        target = base / (label + '-main')
        args, diagnostics = build(compiler, [], base / ('main-skip.cpp' if skip else 'main-checked.cpp'), target)
        for case in cases:
            p = command(['taskset', '-c', '10', str(target)], input=Path(case['input']).read_bytes())
            assert p.stdout == Path(case['expected']).read_bytes(), (label, case['name'],p.stdout)
        result['runs'].append({'kind':'main', 'config':label, 'compile':args,
            'diagnostics':diagnostics, 'cases':len(cases), 'exit':0})
        for kind, source in [('example', root / 'Examples/project_selection_example.cpp'),
                             ('duplicate', base / 'duplicate.cpp')]:
            target = base / (label + '-' + kind)
            args, diagnostics = build(compiler, flags, source, target)
            p = command(['taskset', '-c', '10', str(target)])
            if kind == 'example': assert p.stdout == example_output
            result['runs'].append({'kind':kind, 'config':label, 'compile':args,
                'diagnostics':diagnostics, 'stdout':p.stdout.decode(), 'exit':p.returncode})
        save(); print(label, '212 main fixtures, example, duplicate include PASS', flush=True)
    # Full energy/ownership reference and deep rerouting with both check settings.
    for skip in [False, True]:
        for test in ['reference', 'deep_flow']:
            label = name + ('-skip' if skip else '-checked') + '-sanitized-' + test
            if name != 'clang': continue
            target = base / label
            flags = ['-O1','-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer']
            if skip: flags += ['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
            args, diagnostics = build(compiler, flags,
                root / f'Verify/current/tests/project_selection_{test}_test.cpp', target)
            env = os.environ.copy(); env['ASAN_OPTIONS'] = 'detect_leaks=0'
            p = command(['taskset','-c','10',str(target)], env=env)
            assert not p.stderr, p.stderr.decode()
            result['runs'].append({'kind':'sanitizer','config':label,'compile':args,
                'diagnostics':diagnostics,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'exit':0,
                'environment':{'ASAN_OPTIONS':'detect_leaks=0'}})
            save(); print(label, 'PASS', flush=True)
result['source_unchanged'] = all(digest(root / path) == sha for path,sha in result['source_hashes'].items())
assert result['source_unchanged']
save(); print('ALL CHECKS PASSED',flush=True)
